title: Cairo and Kuwait on Turkish Brass's Calendar: Joint Naval Drill, Air Chief's Visit
excerpt: A busy stretch between Ankara and two Arab capitals: Türkiye's navy chief attended a joint drill in Egypt, and Kuwait's air force commander is in Türkiye for four days.
rank_math_title: Türkiye-Egypt naval drill, Kuwaiti air chief visit | Defence MENA
rank_math_description: Türkiye's navy chief met his Egyptian counterpart during the Sea of Friendship-2026 drill, while Kuwait's air force commander is in Türkiye until 14 November.
